description: This file defines the Fourcc class and related functions for handling Fourcc video format codes, including composition, conversion, and string representation, used in media GPU processing on Chrome OS.

classes.name: Fourcc
classes.description: A class representing Fourcc video format codes with methods for creation, conversion, and string representation.

methods.name: ComposeFourcc
methods.description: Creates a Fourcc code from four characters.

methods.name: FromUint32
methods.description: Creates a Fourcc object from a uint32_t code if valid.

methods.name: FromVideoPixelFormat
methods.description: Converts a VideoPixelFormat to a Fourcc object.

methods.name: ToVideoPixelFormat
methods.description: Returns the VideoPixelFormat corresponding to the Fourcc.

methods.name: ToV4L2PixFmt
methods.description: Returns the V4L2 pixel format code.

methods.name: ToSinglePlanar
methods.description: Returns the single-planar Fourcc equivalent if applicable.

methods.name: IsMultiPlanar
methods.description: Checks if the format is multi-planar.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the Fourcc code.
